finding: V22 pre-provider intent is not sufficient if AccountLease performs an automatic retry/failover after an ambiguous transport failure. The first provider attempt may already have progressed remotely, yet a second account can be called and the final success can clear the intent, losing the uncertainty marker.

exact_source_facts.account_pool_failover: NotionAgentError(TRANSPORT) and httpx.HTTPError are failover-eligible; AccountLease.run can switch account and run retry_operation.
exact_source_facts.server_single_account_extra_retry: handle_openai_responses also has a bounded foreground TRANSPORT retry after AccountPoolExhausted.
exact_source_facts.transport_evidence_semantics: transport_evidence.py classifies incomplete progress observation as INDETERMINATE, not proof of no remote progress.

reproduction.current_v22_plus_lease: intent pending -> provider attempt #1 enters -> ambiguous transport failure -> automatic retry on another account -> provider attempt #2 succeeds -> final publication clears intent
reproduction.result: provider_calls=2 and final state no longer records that attempt #1 may have progressed remotely

required_invariant: A provider intent can be cleared only when the transaction can account for every provider attempt. If any attempt has possible/unknown remote progress, the durable state must remain unresolved and no fresh provider attempt may be started automatically for that exact logical request unless remote-progress absence is explicitly proven.

candidate_policy.retry_rule: Only PROVEN_NO_REMOTE_PROGRESS permits another provider attempt under the same logical intent.
candidate_policy.ambiguous_rule: REMOTE_PROGRESS_POSSIBLE_OR_UNKNOWN leaves/strengthens the durable intent tombstone and returns fail-closed; it must not be converted to a clean success by a sibling-account retry.
candidate_policy.http_error_rule: Generic httpx.HTTPError must be treated as ambiguous unless a lower layer supplies an explicit no-remote-progress proof.
candidate_policy.timeout_rule: Existing outer timeout already fails closed and is compatible with this invariant.
candidate_policy.existing_failover_impact: This may intentionally suppress the current transport failover path for ambiguous attempts until the transport layer exposes a reliable no-remote-progress classification. Rotation policy itself is unchanged; only uncertain continuation is blocked.

next: Fold V23 into the combined V12-V22 candidate before product materialization. The server/account-pool integration must not clear an unresolved provider intent after a transport failover whose first attempt has incomplete response-progress observation.
